tie_policy: ROC/AP from sklearn (ties get the midpoint rank); recall@FPR uses a threshold at the (1-fpr) quantile of eligible negatives with method='higher' and counts scores strictly greater than it
note: every model is evaluated on this identical eligible set; the forecaster's missing-history rows are removed from ALL models so the comparison is like-for-like
bootstrap: cluster bootstrap over 4 malicious users, 2000 draws, benign cohort fixed — DESCRIPTIVE at this cluster count
